async def act(page):
    # Wait for the 'technology' category link to be visible and click it with a longer timeout
    technology_link = page.get_by_role('link', name='technology', exact=True).first
    await technology_link.wait_for(state='visible', timeout=10000)  # Wait up to 10 seconds for visibility
    await technology_link.click(timeout=10000)  # Click with a longer timeout
    await page.wait_for_load_state('load')  # Wait for the new page to load
    # No further actions needed as the task is to navigate to the page
